hospitalDetails.name: Broward Health Medical Center
hospitalDetails.address: 251 E Las Olas Blvd, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33301
hospitalDetails.paragraph: Broward Health Medical Center anchors Broward County maternity care from downtown Fort Lauderdale, and its Maternity Place program is built around family-centered care: dedicated labor care, postpartum support, and a team that coordinates with doulas and support persons from the moment you check in. It's the county's highest-volume hospital, which means the L&D team moves fast — write your birth preferences down and hand them over at triage so nothing gets lost in the room. If your baby arrives early or small, the Level III NICU is right on site.

hospitalDetails.name: Holy Cross Hospital Fort Lauderdale
hospitalDetails.address: 2601 N Federal Hwy, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33305
hospitalDetails.paragraph: Holy Cross Hospital on North Federal Highway, in Fort Lauderdale's east end, is the area's other major maternity destination. It handles a solid volume of routine low-risk and higher-complexity births, with an OB team, postpartum unit and NICU under one roof, and its own campus of clinics for prenatal appointments. Doulas are welcome as support persons — confirm the current visitor policy when you tour or call the patient-line number on holy-cross.com before labor day.
